name: Jundong Liu
title: Professor; Director, Learning & Intelligent Systems Lab
department: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
fitReason: Concrete connection between reinforcement learning and physical mobile-robot control, with explainable reward design and sim-to-real evaluation. The broader group also studies medical imaging and computer vision, so a robotics-specific project and supervision capacity need confirmation.

physicalEvidence.summary: The January 30, 2026 Coulomb-force-guided DRL study trains TD3 navigation policies in Gazebo and executes them on the lab's TurtleBot3 Burger. A remote PC sends real-time actions through ROS 2 to the robot's Raspberry Pi 4/OpenCR; LiDAR supports obstacle processing. Physical tests include static, enlarged and moving obstacles. Five rollouts per model per scene are reported, a limited empirical evaluation rather than a general safety guarantee. The paper identifies all authors with Ohio's LiSL; Ohio's Fall2025 commencement record identifies first author Sirui Song's robotics dissertation and Liu as director.

shortVisit.summary: No current external visitor, summer intern or eight-week invitation was verified. The current university profile establishes faculty status and research activity, not a placement offer. Its linked lab website failed direct retrieval.
